C0310.title: Wan'an Public Security Cracks a DDoS Hacking Case
C0310.summary: In December 2022, the Cyber Surveillance Unit of the Wan'an County Public Security Bureau identified a resident surnamed Song who was conducting DDoS attacks against a website, suspected of endangering network security. Officers located and summoned the suspect after analysis and investigation. The investigation revealed that Song obtained DDoS attack scripts while building websites for others and
